req.title: Return PUT request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to PUT /put with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /put returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with a JSON body payload, (2) verify form-encoded data is reflected, (3) verify query-string args are reflected, (4) verify the negative path when using a disallowed method (GET on /put), (5) verify boundary behavior with an empty body, and (6) verify JSON payload is parsed and reflected. Each test asserts exact values to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_plain_text_body_returns_200_with_all_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put endpoint is registered
actions: Send PUT /put with plain text body 'hello'
Inspect response status code and JSON keys
expected: JSON body contains exactly keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
json field is null (not valid JSON)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_plain_text_body_returns_200_with_all_keys():
    r = client.put('/put', data=b'hello', content_type='text/plain')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert body['data'] == 'hello'
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['args'] == {}
    assert body['files'] == {}
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert 'url' in body
    assert '/put' in body['url']

test_put_plain_text_body_returns_200_with_all_keys()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_headers_reflected_in_response():
    r = client.put('/put', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert headers_lower.get('x-test-header') == 'sentinel'

tests.name: test_put_url_field_contains_put_path
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put endpoint is registered
actions: Inspect url field in response body
expected: url field is a non-empty string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_url_field_contains_put_path():
    r = client.put('/put')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    url = body['url']
    assert isinstance(url, str)
    assert len(url) > 0
    assert url.endswith('/put')
    assert not url.endswith('/post')
    assert not url.endswith('/patch')
    assert not url.endswith('/delete')

test_put_url_field_contains_put_path()

tests.name: test_put_nested_json_body_reflected_exactly
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
PUT /put endpoint is registered
actions: Send PUT /put with nested JSON body
Inspect json field in response body
expected: json field equals the exact nested structure sent
data field is the raw JSON string
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_nested_json_body_reflected_exactly():
    payload = {"outer": {"inner": 42}, "list": [1, 2, 3]}
    raw = json.dumps(payload)
    r = client.put('/put', data=raw, content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['json'] == payload
    assert body['json']['outer']['inner'] == 42
    assert body['json']['list'] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == raw

test_put_nested_json_body_reflected_exactly()
